probeRecords.observation: The wide steady viewport preserves aligned gutters, a balanced two-column setup card, readable controls, and an unobscured primary action.
At 1024 pixels the shell collapses into a course-navigation row while the setup and lower two-column grids remain readable and collision-free.
At 1023 pixels the header reorganizes into two rows without clipping navigation, breadcrumb, setup controls, summary, or the start action.
At effective 125 percent the breadcrumb ends after “Mock interview”; the current Setup segment is absent with no wrap or ellipsis.
At effective 80 percent the full breadcrumb, title, tabs, setup heading, and selected control remain legible and contained.
After zoom restoration the complete breadcrumb and normal compact gutters return with no residual displacement or clipping.
At scroll start the compact shell, breadcrumb, title, tabs, preparation heading, and top of the setup card are visible and unobscured.
At middle scroll the changed selection, matching readiness summary, purple launch action, and following history section remain readable.
At terminal scroll both empty-state cards are fully readable, the scrollbar shows the page end, and no fixed surface covers content.
Container-not-present: the pixels show one page scrollbar and no independently bounded scrolling surface.
The designated long-English start capture shows gray skeleton bars in place of the page title and introduction, so steady long-copy wrapping is not evidenced.
Long English terminal messages wrap within both compact cards with visible side padding and no clipping.
The selected Cao cấp and Thiết kế hệ thống states visibly match the readiness summary below, with a clear launch action.
The resume panel and continue action render, but the logo and leading breadcrumb are visibly clipped off the left viewport edge.
The retry card is clear, but the long recovery breadcrumb is cut mid-word at the right edge instead of wrapping or eliding safely.
The opaque course drawer, dim scrim, selected interview row, and circular close control are distinct and free of label clipping.
After closing the drawer the scrim disappears and the compact page returns to normal gutters with visible controls and no residual occlusion.
Interaction-not-present: no draggable handle, reorder surface, slider thumb, or drag affordance appears in the supplied rasters.
The Overview tab has a visible focus ring, but the compact shell and breadcrumb are displaced and clipped at the left viewport edge.
The final host-context raster preserves rail clearance, centered desktop gutters, aligned neighboring cards, and an unobscured start action.
